controls.name: identity / no control
controls.role: A recursive loop must be shown to grow or ring; identity is an instability control, never a pass.

controls.name: fixed -5 dB gain margin
controls.role: Conservative no-reference baseline comparator only; attenuation is scored separately from howl reduction and is not a selection.

controls.name: notch only versus notch plus margin
controls.role: Separates tone detection from global gain reduction so neither is credited for the other.

controls.name: AFC only versus AFC plus margin
controls.role: Separates playback-reference path estimation from fixed attenuation; AFC must not be credited when its gain is supplied by the margin.

controls.name: clean speech false activation
controls.role: A howl detector must not fire on ordinary speech; tonal vowels and sustained vowels are a required stress stratum.

controls.name: silence and no-loop passthrough
controls.role: Silence must stay silent and a no-loop path must remain passthrough; a forced notch or gain event is a false positive.

controls.name: music and sustained-tone false trigger
controls.role: Music, harmonics and sustained notes are tonal but not feedback; detector precision and speech damage are scored separately.

controls.name: loop-gain and delay sweep
controls.role: Stable, marginal and unstable loop gains plus delay changes expose onset detection and recovery; one gain is not a stability result.

controls.name: pre-tanh and post-clip saturation
controls.role: Amplifier/loudspeaker nonlinearity changes the feedback path; linear-only results do not cover clipping cases.

controls.name: path change, reference mismatch and recovery
controls.role: A changed path or shifted playback reference must adapt or fail closed; a residual or sustained howl is a failure, not a slow pass.

controls.name: double-talk-like and abrupt level change
controls.role: Near-end speech and abrupt level changes must not be suppressed as feedback; near-end damage is a first-order outcome.

controls.name: adverse config and frame rejection
controls.role: Missing, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong-shape, stale-epoch and wrong-position inputs must fail closed with unchanged state.
